$comment: Auto-merge policy for the coding lane. v2 (operator decision 2026-07-28, Aaron): human-merge holds are OFF for trading logic, config, cron, and schema — 'I would prefer mistakes be made and system discovers and merge again rather than undefined behavior.' The gates (py_compile, changed tests, repo checks incl. money-path CI) decide; merges page Aaron with a revert command. The ONLY remaining holds are the self-referential/unrecoverable core: (a) the merge machinery itself — a bad merge there can disable the system's ability to merge its own fix; (b) credentials + token/restart scripts — a bricked fleet auth needs a human /login and cannot self-discover; (c) the trace/guard layer every governed script depends on; (d) container compose + CI injection. Agents must never widen this file (it is itself protected).
